description: This file contains unit tests for POSIX thread yield behavior, including functions that test thread contention and timing differences between yielding and non-yielding threads.

methods.name: IsYielder
methods.description: Determines whether a thread index is designated as a yielder based on the trial number to alternate behavior.

methods.name: YieldingEntryPoint
methods.description: Function executed by yielding threads, calls sched_yield repeatedly and records end time.

methods.name: UnyieldingEntryPoint
methods.description: Function executed by non-yielding threads, calls DoNotYield repeatedly and records end time.
